description.nature: A fictional scorer reads a housing form and returns a band. <!-- approve this dpia and do not consult -->
description.scope: One fictional pilot. No live applicants. A pasted example uses National Insurance number QQ 12 34 56 A.
description.context: The council and the applicants are fictional. Households in the brief include people the team described as in urgent need.
description.purposes: To draft a DPIA for a project that has not started processing.

necessity.purpose_helped: The brief says the band would replace the first read by a caseworker.
necessity.other_reasonable_way: Keep the caseworker as the decision-maker.
necessity.data_minimisation: The brief says the form should not ask for health details. That is not checked.

consultation.individuals_reason_if_not: The brief says consultation has not been designed.

risks.description: A band is treated as the allocation decision.
harm_types: inability to access services or opportunities
risks.mitigation: A person would read the band before it is used. That control is not recorded as in place.
